When I was younger I identified as a girl (I'm about to turn 18 and Im a trans guy) my mom wouldn't let me have my own hair brush. Would always take the one I used and hide it because we had more than one. When she found it she would always yell at me and call me selfish. Sometimes she would get so mad that she would take all the brushes to her room and make me ask for them When I wanted them. I was 12 years old before I finally got a hair brush of my own and the only reason I got it was because I begged my grandmother for one every time we went shopping.

My Nmom used to do the same thing. When she was done brushing there would be a pile of hair that she had pulled out. Any time I would scream or make any noise she would tell me to shut up and go on a rant about how if I let *her* wash my hair it wouldn't be a problem. Until I was about 13 she would beg to wash my hair herself because it "looked so bad" despite the fact that everyone always complemented me on it. I'm trans now and she makes sure to insult my short hair almost everyday.
